## Checklist

- [ ] A story shows the change, and its `play` test fails without it.
- [ ] Screenshots (light, dark, phone) for a visual change.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally.
- [ ] Sample data is made up: placeholder names (`acme`, `example.com`,
      `~/code/app`), no real people, machines, paths, hosts, IDs or text
      from a real project or conversation.
- [ ] Code, comments and samples in English; another language only where a
      story tests one.
- [ ] Components still come from shadcn; a fixed file says why with an
      `// agent-ui:` comment and is listed in `registry.json`.
- [ ] No change to `src/index.css` by hand (`pnpm theme` writes it).
